note: Halen: rhomboid second wall of 1385 (wet ditch and ironstone wall, three gates), damaged in 1567 and 1572 and not repaired until 1706, so in 1650 a ruinous enceinte. Traced from the Ferraris map (1777, earthen rampart with half-bastions); the later extension east to the Gete is left out.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Halen' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140194)

gateSources.Luikerpoort: inventory 140194 (east, where the wall crosses the Velpe)
